methods.support_constrained_max_coverage: candidate centers restricted to the top 5% training-only NDVI support mask; greedily maximize newly covered public land-grid cells within 1 km
methods.coverage_only_max_coverage: all public grid cells eligible; same greedy maximum newly covered land-grid objective
methods.matched_random: same island counts as support-constrained max-coverage; 500 draws per fold

promotion_gate: support-constrained method must exceed both coverage-only and matched-random at taxon level with bootstrap lower95>0 and sign-flip p<0.05
hard_boundaries: No new support quantile search in this strong-comparator audit.
